case.name: tipo_cuenta_no_permitido
case.description: Account type PRE is not allowed: error 50001 before any lookup.

case.name: pago_cuenta_cte_permitida
case.description: Account type CTE is accepted; company tariff 2.00 'N', channel VEN, full payment flow.

case.name: pago_cuenta_aho_web_tarifa_empresa
case.description: Account type AHO accepted; WEB channel pays half of the 2.00 company tariff (1.00); total 101.00 debited.

case.name: orden_no_existe
case.description: The order does not exist: error 50002.

case.name: orden_de_otra_empresa_no_existe
case.description: The order number exists but for a different company: treated as not found (50002).

case.name: orden_no_pendiente_anulada
case.description: Order in status 'C' is rejected with error 50003.

case.name: orden_no_pendiente_ya_pagada
case.description: Order already in status 'A' cannot be paid twice: error 50003.

case.name: tarifa_empresa_prevalece_sobre_servicio
case.description: Both company tariff (2.00 'N') and service default (5.00) exist; the company tariff wins. Channel VEN so commission = 2.00.

case.name: tarifa_servicio_por_defecto
case.description: No company tariff row for AGUA: service default 1.50 applies and separada is 'N'; channel VEN pays 1.50, total 101.50.

case.name: tarifa_servicio_nula_es_cero
case.description: No company row and the service default tariff is NULL: tariff becomes 0, commission 0, total = value.

case.name: tarifa_empresa_nula_es_cero
case.description: Company row exists with NULL tariff value and separada 'N': tariff becomes 0.

case.name: sin_tarifa_ni_servicio
case.description: Neither company tariff nor service row exists: tariff 0 and separada left unassigned (NULL), so the total includes the commission (0).

case.name: comision_web_redondeo
case.description: WEB channel with tariff 1.25: commission = round(0.625, 2) = 0.63, total 100.63.

case.name: comision_otro_canal_tarifa_completa
case.description: Non-WEB channel with tariff 1.25: full commission 1.25, total 101.25.

case.name: nomina_exenta_canal_web
case.description: Service NOMINA with WEB channel and tariff 3.00: commission forced to 0, total = value.

case.name: nomina_exenta_otro_canal
case.description: Service NOMINA with a non-WEB channel and tariff 3.00: commission still 0.

case.name: comision_separada_dos_debitos
case.description: Company tariff 2.00 with separada 'S', channel VEN: first debit is the value (100.00), second debit is the commission (2.00) with reference 'COMISION PAGO'.

case.name: comision_separada_con_comision_cero
case.description: Separada 'S' but NOMINA makes the commission 0: no second debit is made.

case.name: comision_no_separada_un_solo_debito
case.description: Separada 'N' with commission > 0: only one debit (value + commission), no separate commission movement.

case.name: comision_separada_debito_falla
case.description: Separada 'S', commission 2.00: value debit succeeds but the commission debit returns non-zero: error 50006.

case.name: fondos_vir_exactos
case.description: VIR account: balance 102.00 equals the total (100.00 + 2.00): accepted (upper edge of the limit).

case.name: fondos_vir_un_centavo_menos
case.description: VIR account: balance 101.99 is one cent below the total 102.00: error 50004.

case.name: fondos_no_vir_limite_sobregiro_exacto
case.description: AHO account: balance 2.00 + 100.00 overdraft equals the total 102.00: accepted.

case.name: fondos_no_vir_un_centavo_mas_alla_sobregiro
case.description: AHO account: balance 1.99 + 100.00 is one cent below the total 102.00: error 50004.

case.name: fondos_cte_saldo_negativo_dentro_sobregiro
case.description: CTE account with negative balance -10.00 and total 90.00 (no tariff): -10 + 100 = 90 covers the total exactly.

case.name: cuenta_inexistente_saldo_nulo
case.description: Account row does not exist: balance stays NULL, the funds check is unknown; characterizes the legacy behaviour (suspected defect).

case.name: debito_falla_error_50005
case.description: The debit of the total returns non-zero: rollback and error 50005; the order stays pending.

case.name: orden_pagada_actualiza_estado_fecha_comision
case.description: Successful payment: order moves to 'A' with payment date 2026-03-02T09:30:00 and stored commission 0.63 (WEB, tariff 1.25).
